macros.name: ellipsisgap
macros.doc: You may wish to redefine the command \ellipsisgap, which is the space between the dots of the ellipsis.

macros.name: midwordellipsis
macros.doc: An extra command: this may be useful for the rare time when you want an ellipsis in the very middle of a word or whenever you just want a small bit of space (the intra-ellipsis spacing) before and after the ellipsis.
